nodes.label: Settings area (/settings)
nodes.rationale: Sidebar of sections mirroring deployment concerns; sections you lack permission for are hidden.

nodes.label: Hybrid settings model (.env default → app_settings override)
nodes.rationale: UI writes an app_settings row that takes effect without a restart; each field shows its source (db/env/default) and a reset button that falls back to the env value.

nodes.label: Settings sections (General, Features, Scanning, Backup, Users, Appearance, Color Rules, Data)
nodes.rationale: Features groups behavior toggles by concern — scanner reconciliation, scan targeting (auto-create prefixes, VRF inference), inbox expiry, data retention, cert warn window, site cascade — all defaults reproducing the original behavior.

nodes.label: Backup & restore settings
nodes.rationale: User accounts excluded by default (admins always) with admin opt-in for non-admin accounts; restores are atomic, ID-preserving and keep you logged in.

nodes.label: Data & Maintenance danger zone (purges, factory reset)
nodes.rationale: Irreversible tools — factory reset wipes data tables but users survive; audited and permission-gated.
